title: Cut dashboard render cost
objective: Remove the repeated per-update work that makes the panel feel laggy. The window shadow is invalidated on every SwiftUI update because updateNSView reconfigures a non-opaque window unconditionally; the issue list filters and searches the whole corpus four or five times per render through an uncached computed property, using locale-aware substring matching over full markdown descriptions; the list builds every row eagerly in a plain VStack; and translucent materials are stacked several deep over a transparent window. Keep the visible design, including Liquid Glass on macOS 26 and the Reduce Transparency fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: The window is reconfigured only when its identity or its inputs actually change; invalidateShadow no longer runs on every SwiftUI update.
Filtering and search results are computed once per input change rather than recomputed by every view that reads them.
Search matching avoids locale-aware comparison over long description text while still matching case-insensitively.
Issue rows are built lazily, so off-screen rows cost nothing until scrolled to.
Translucency is not stacked more than one layer deep over the same pixels, and Liquid Glass on macOS 26, the pre-26 material fallback, and the Reduce Transparency path all still render.
Filtering behaviour is unchanged: same issues shown for the same filters, search text and project scope, covered by unit tests.
swift build and git diff --check pass.
